title: SolveSpace NG review 2: panels and overlays
brief: Every panel and overlay, dark and light. Keep, tweak or rethink, with a note.

sheets.label: window
sheets.question: The whole window (dark only): Outliner left, tool shelf top, Properties right, view cube bottom left, status bar.

sheets.label: outliner
sheets.question: Outliner: active radio, visibility, status (ok / degrees of freedom left / ERR), name. Onshape and Fusion show a type icon per row and call the references 'Origin' / 'Default geometry'.

sheets.label: properties group
sheets.question: Properties of a group (nothing selected).

sheets.label: properties line
sheets.question: Properties of a selected line. Labels come from the old browser ('thru', 'len', 'from request'); lengths have no units.

sheets.label: properties dimension
sheets.question: Properties of a selected dimension: the value shows full precision (16.4924225025), and the line it constrains is listed twice.

sheets.label: problems
sheets.question: Problems, after constraining a dimensioned line both horizontal and vertical.

sheets.label: preferences
sheets.question: Preferences, top (Display section).

sheets.label: preferences more
sheets.question: Preferences, bottom: the NG section (theme, keys) comes last.

sheets.label: styles
sheets.question: Line styles: the built-in styles show internal names (s001-#def-active-grp).

sheets.label: view
sheets.question: View panel (Edit > View Projection): scale, origin, projection, lighting.

sheets.label: paste transformed
sheets.question: Paste Transformed.

sheets.label: step dimension
sheets.question: Step Dimension (shows the internal name c002-pt-pt-distance).

sheets.label: tangent arc
sheets.question: Tangent Arc settings.

sheets.label: shelf
sheets.question: Tool shelf (View > Show Toolbar).

sheets.label: palette
sheets.question: Command palette (Space), searching 'con'.

sheets.label: pie add
sheets.question: Add pie (Shift+A): text only; Blender's pies carry icons.

sheets.label: pie constrain
sheets.question: Constrain pie (F) for two lines: only the constraints that apply.

sheets.label: pie view
sheets.question: View pie (`).

sheets.label: status bar
sheets.question: Status bar: keys for now, active group, degrees of freedom, solver state.

sheets.label: view cube
sheets.question: View cube with the reference axes.

sheets.label: context menu
sheets.question: Right-click menu on a line: 'Group Info' / 'Style Info' are the old browser's names (they open Properties now); no Grab, Dimension, Constrain or Hide.
